newsitem.title: USA: Norwest to buy International Bancorporation.
newsitem.headline: Norwest to buy International Bancorporation.

text.p: Norwest Corp said Thursday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire International Bancorporation, which operates 17 bank offices in central and northern Minnesota.
Financial terms were not announced, but Norwest said the Golden Valley, Minnesota-based bank holding company has assets of $507 million.
The deal is subject to completion of due diligence and shareholder and regulatory approval, Norwest said.
Norwest provides banking, insurance, mortgage and consumer finance services.
Its shares were up 1-3/8 Thursday at 47-1/2.
